**Fix:** In `src/orders-web/orders_page.py`, I registered `export` next to `refresh`. I also added `test_export_button_writes_one_download` in `tests/test_orders_web.py`, which clicks the button through `click("export")`.

- Before the fix, the new test failed with `AssertionError: 0 != 1`. (verified)
